records.title: Improving Thematic Balance in Press Release Generation with GMMs and Dimensionality Reduction
records.reason: Author-affiliated Centre Borelli publication record gives the exact title, venue and abstract. It describes embedding-space augmentation and fine-tuning for press-release generation quality, with no inference-system, serving, runtime, or resource-efficiency contribution.

records.title: SSFusion: Tensor Fusion with Selective Sparsification for Efficient Distributed DNN Training
records.reason: The DOI/title are confirmed by the ICDE 2026 proceedings record and bibliographic metadata, but IEEE Xplore abstract/document/00107 was inaccessible. A non-publisher abstract summary indicates distributed-training communication optimization; it was not substituted for primary evidence.

records.title: Achieving Real-Time Execution of Transformer-based Large-scale Models on Mobile with Compiler-aware Neural Architecture Optimization
records.reason: The framework selects device-fitting BERT structures for mobile resource and real-time limits, reporting latency reductions.

records.title: MSP: An FPGA-Specific Mixed-Scheme, Multi-Precision Deep Neural Network Quantization Framework
records.reason: FPGA-specific intra-layer mixed precision targets resource use and compute overhead for edge inference.

records.title: Less, but Better: Efficient Multilingual Expansion for LLMs via Layer-wise Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: The method reduces expert counts in continual LLM expansion (60%/33.3% fewer experts); model-size and inference efficiency are directly relevant.

records.title: Don't Run with Scissors: Pruning Breaks VLA Models but They Can Be Recovered
records.reason: The abstract studies VLA pruning and recovery with retained memory-efficiency benefits and low inference overhead.

records.title: ETA-VLA: Efficient Token Adaptation via Temporal Fusion and Intra-LLM Sparsification for Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: Temporal token fusion and pruning reduce visual tokens and inference FLOPs while preserving driving accuracy.

records.title: A Deep Dive into Task-Based Parallelism in Python
records.reason: Primary paper PDF reports heterogeneous task-runtime mechanisms, 3–6x gains under GIL contention and lower multi-GPU launch overhead.

records.title: Training Large-scale Foundation Models on Emerging AI Chips
records.reason: ACM DOI metadata and the official KDD 2023 tutorial listing confirm the item title and venue. The ACM Digital Library DOI page returned HTTP 403; the tutorial page is not the publication abstract, so the primary abstract could not be screened.

records.title: BrickDL: Graph-Level Optimizations for DNNs with Fine-Grained Data Blocking on GPUs
records.reason: Primary paper describes graph-level fused execution/data blocking to improve GPU memory locality and end-to-end inference performance.

records.title: Transformer-Driven Large Language Models for Context-Aware Semantic Reasoning and Domain-Specific Text Generation
records.reason: The publisher abstract is generic domain-specific LLM generation and mentions PEFT among several approaches but gives no concrete inference/runtime efficiency mechanism or measured system effect.

records.title: EvoCurr: Self-evolving Curriculum with Behavior Code Generation for Complex Decision-making
records.reason: The abstract targets complex game/decision-making agents and reports task success, without a system-efficiency contribution.

records.title: LLM Enabled Multi-Agent System for 6G Networks: Framework and Method of Dual-Loop Edge-Terminal Collaboration
records.reason: Dual-loop edge/terminal collaboration and offloading address limited device resources in LLM-agent execution.

records.title: Elastic Spiking Transformers for Efficient Gesture Understanding
records.reason: Dynamic width/head selection fits hardware memory budgets and lowers synaptic operations for edge inference.

records.title: μRWKV: A Memory-Efficient Model for Time-Series Prediction of Greenhouse Temperature and Energy Loads
records.reason: The official IECON 2025 program confirms the exact title/authors; DOI metadata indexes the IEEE conference paper. IEEE Xplore did not yield the paper page or abstract on retry. The model’s memory-efficiency relevance therefore remains unassessed from primary abstract text.

records.title: Real-Time Fraud Detection Using Large Language Models: A Context-Aware System for Mitigating Social Engineering Threats
records.reason: The journal publisher page gives the exact article title and abstract. It proposes an LLM-based fraud-detection application for social-engineering threats; no inference/runtime/serving optimization is described.

records.title: EFFICIENT MRI-BASED BRAIN TUMOR CLASSIFICATION USING PRUNED SQUEEZENET ARCHITECTURE
records.reason: The publisher abstract describes structured pruning of SqueezeNet specifically for MRI brain-tumor classification in resource-constrained medical settings. It does not establish a connection to LLM inference systems or a general serving/runtime technique, so this application-specific CNN result is outside the survey scope.

records.title: Toward Scalable LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration: A Dynamic Task Graph Approach with Asynchronous Parallel Execution
records.reason: The MDPI publisher page provides the title and abstract. DynTaskMAS uses a runtime task graph, asynchronous ready-task scheduling, and semantic context routing; the abstract reports lower execution time/token transfer and increased GPU utilization in LLM-agent execution.

records.title: ShareDAB-DETR: Memory-Efficient Object Detection through CentralBank Parameter Sharing
records.reason: SciTePress primary abstract describes transformer parameter sharing with large parameter/memory reductions and edge-device deployment; the system-efficiency connection is explicit.

records.title: A Performance Evaluation of a Quantized Large Language Model on Various Smartphones
records.reason: The abstract evaluates real-world LLM inference speed and thermal behavior across resource-limited smartphones.
